'''2005 Alderaan Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional played in California on 22 January 2005<ref name="pcf-4383-59728">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59728#59728 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Peter Nordstrom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and a qualifier for the [[2005 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-4383-59712">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59712#59712 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Peter Nordstrom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Steve Sanders]] ran it.<ref name="pcf-4383-60505">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60505#60505 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Peter Nordstrom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Fifteen players took part and [[Peter Nordstrom]] won, earning the right to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]].<ref name="pcf-4383-60502">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60502#60502 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Day 2 byes went to Peter Nordstrom and [[Philip Green]].<ref name="pc-events05">[http://swccgpc.com/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing], swccgpc.com (updated 27 June 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' California
* '''Dates:''' 22 January 2005<ref name="pcf-4383-59728" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="pcf-4383-60505" />
* '''Entry fee:''' about $10 (expected)<ref name="pcf-4383-59861">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59861#59861 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Prizes:''' the Players Committee's Ultimate Prize Package<ref name="pcf-4383-59861" />
* '''Players:''' 15<ref name="pcf-4383-60502" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Peter Nordstrom]]<ref name="pcf-4383-60502" />
* '''Day 2 byes:''' [[Peter Nordstrom]], [[Philip Green]]<ref name="pc-events05" />

== Organization ==

Sanders promoted the tournament through a UC Berkeley Star Wars CCG discussion group of eleven people and expected more than twenty players. He first planned prize support of Star Wars CCG and [[WARS TCG]] boosters, with WARS packs to be bought from Eudemonia on the day of the tournament.<ref name="pcf-4383-59713">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59713#59713 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Nordstrom, who planned to drive in from Sonora with [[Clayton Atkin]], asked for the Players Committee's Ultimate Prize Package instead, which included the design of a Virtual Card.<ref name="pcf-4383-59712" /><ref name="pcf-4383-59714">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59714#59714 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Peter Nordstrom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4383-59728" /> Sanders put in a request form for the package,<ref name="pcf-4383-59781">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59781#59781 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050227223134/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=59811%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and on 11 January 2005 he posted that the order had been approved and that the entry fee would rise to about $10 to cover it.<ref name="pcf-4383-59861" />

Because no final confrontation had been planned, Sanders said that he would adjust Nordstrom's final differential by two in Decipher's tournament system so that Nordstrom would be recorded as the winner there as well.<ref name="pcf-4383-60502" /> [[Brandon Schele]] told Nordstrom to send his Virtual Card design to [[Doug Taylor]].<ref name="pcf-4383-60520">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520#60520 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Brandon Schele, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Decks ===

Sanders posted the decks played; one player's decks were not recorded.<ref name="pcf-4383-60649" />

* '''Light Side:''' Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed; WYS ×2; [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This / Duel of the Fates]] ×3; Agents In The Court ("Broken Bargain"); There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him; Profit; [[Careful Planning (V)]] on Endor; Local Uprising (V); Hidden Base ×2; Quiet Mining Colony.<ref name="pcf-4383-60649" />
* '''Dark Side:''' [[Combat Readiness (V)]] on Tatooine ×2; Set Your Course for Alderaan ×2; Hunt Down ×2; Combat Readiness (V) on Bespin ×2; No Money, No Parts, No Deal; Invasion; My Kind of Scum ×2; Combat Readiness (V) on Hoth; Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V).<ref name="pcf-4383-60649" />

Several Dark Side decks went undefeated: Nordstrom's My Kind of Scum and two Hunt Down decks, one played by a player named Philip and one by a player posting as l000needles, each went 3–0. No Light Side deck went undefeated.<ref name="pcf-4383-60657" /><ref name="pcf-4383-60676">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60676#60676 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], l000needles, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Fourth place ===

A player posting as PhataLerror took fourth place with Invasion and an Agents In The Court deck he called "Broken Bargain". He lost his second game to Clayton Atkin's My Kind of Scum. In his last game the tournament director and four nearby players ruled that the printed word "ignored" on [[Imperial Decree]] stopped the "may not be canceled" text of [[Tawss Khaa (V)]]; he won the game anyway.<ref name="pcf-4383-60625" /> Nordstrom replied that Imperial Decree's text had been changed from "ignore" to "cancel" in the 2002 Glossary supplement on the Players Committee rules page,<ref name="pcf-4383-60640">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60640#60640 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Peter Nordstrom, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and Sanders apologized for the ruling.<ref name="pcf-4383-60642">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60642#60642 California/Alderaan Regional - Who's going?], Steve Sanders, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226014820/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60520%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> PhataLerror's prizes were two [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] packs, an [[Insurrection]] foil, four [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] packs, two [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] packs, a [[WARS TCG|WARS]] Nowhere To Hide pack and an uncut sheet of Light Side Tatooine rares.<ref name="pcf-4383-60625" />
